description:
Use this when you need planetary positions across a range of dates, for a transit table or to find when a planet changes sign or stations.
Positions from start to end (inclusive) every stepMinutes, for transit tables and station finding. At most 1,000 points (too_many_points beyond). A 365-point daily table costs 4 credits.
Cost: 1 credit per started 100 points (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer.
Example arguments: {"start":"2026-10-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-10-10T00:00:00Z","stepMinutes":1440,"bodies":["Mercury","Venus"]}

items.description: MeanNode and TrueNode are Rāhu (mean or true); Ketu is the node + 180°. Every AstroNest chart, reading and timing endpoint uses the mean node.

end.description: ISO 8601 with Z or an explicit offset, between 1800-01-02 and 2149-12-31 UTC. A time without a zone is refused (invalid_datetime).

start.description: ISO 8601 with Z or an explicit offset, between 1800-01-02 and 2149-12-31 UTC. A time without a zone is refused (invalid_datetime).

stepMinutes.description: Minutes between points (1 to 525,600). At most 1,000 points per call.
